items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: I said well if my dad was a good song so I would be able to sing too.

ctx.x: But you never got no singing lessons did you? Never taken a lesson in the day of my life. But you just sort of felt that you'd sing.
I just picked it up, just picked it up. I said well if my dad was a good song so I would be able to sing too.
